Read Me: Mosques & Islamic Centres Database — Canada (v2)
Updated September 2026 after user-reported corrections. 30 Montreal-area entries + 5 other cities. 100+ locations total.
WHAT CHANGED IN v2:
• ADDED Al-Madinah Center (1260 Rue Mackay) — was missing entirely. Full program & fee data now included.
• CORRECTED Khadijah Mosque — its website khadijahmtl.org was missed in v1. Real fees now listed ($75/mo Quran classes).
• ADDED Salahouddine Mosque (6691 Av du Parc) — one of the most program-dense mosques in the city; was missing.
• ADDED Mosquée Al-Rawdah, Centre Communautaire Laurentien, Centre Communautaire Villeray/Abou Bakr, Association Al-Bayan, Turkish Muslim Association of Montreal.
• CORRECTED websites for: Mosquée Madani (academyannoor.com), CIC Al-Jamieh (cical-jamieh.com), Masjid As-Salam (salam-mosque.org), CIIC (theciic.com), Centre Islamique de Verdun (civmac.ca).
• NEW TAB 'Programs & Pricing' — one row per program/class/workshop/event with cost and free-vs-paid status.
TABS:
• Montreal (Island) — 26 entries, full detail. Highlighted rows are new or corrected.
• Programs & Pricing — ~60 individual programs with verified costs where published.
• Greater Montreal / Toronto / Ottawa / Sherbrooke / Quebec City / Vancouver (Metro) — location, coordinates, maps link, phone, rating, notes.
ON PRICING — HOW TO READ IT:
• Every dollar figure came from the organization's own website or its live registration page (Zeffy, JotForm, Stripe). Nothing is estimated or guessed.
• 'Not published' means the fee genuinely is not posted anywhere online — those rows give the phone number instead. Many Montreal mosques announce fees only via Facebook, WhatsApp or printed posters.
• Some fees live inside poster IMAGES (e.g. Khadijah's camp posters) which can't be read as text — flagged where relevant.
KNOWN GAPS — worth a manual check:
• Small musallahs and prayer rooms (university campuses, shops, community basements) are largely not covered.
• Program schedules change every term. Anything here should be re-verified before publishing.
• If you know of other mosques I've missed, send the names and I'll add them with the same level of detail.

Montreal (Island).Name: Al-Madinah Center (Association Salam Paix de Montréal)
Montreal (Island).Programs / Classes / Events: ARABIC SCHOOL (Sundays, some Sat): 3 streams — Arabic Language, Quranic Recitation, Islamic Manners. QURAN ACADEMY: weekly Quran / Hifz / Tajweed circles, all levels & ages, teachers with Ijaza in all Qira'at, flexible schedule. Quran Halaqat for adults (brothers & sisters). SUMMER CAMP (8 wks): robotics/coding for kids, weekly pool visit, skating at nearby arena, Friday group restaurant meals, outdoor daily activity. Also: Zakat financial support, Seniors' Support, Orphan Sponsorship, Food Bank, Scholarships, Ramadan iftar distribution + daily contest, Eid prayers (6:00 & 7:00 AM), library, conference room, multi-purpose hall.
Montreal (Island).Pricing (verified where stated): ARABIC SCHOOL 2025-26: Pay in full $700 ($50 registration + $650 tuition); early-bird pay-in-full $650 (registration waived); 'Register now, pay later' $50 deposit then installments Sept $250 / Jan $200 / Mar $200. Optional lunch (pizza + juice) $150. SUMMER CAMP 2026: $150/week; all 8 weeks $1,100 (saves $100); deposit-only option $50; early drop-off +$25; late pick-up +$25. Zakat-ul-Fitr $15/person; Fidya/Kaffara $15. Prayers/halaqat free.

Montreal (Island).Name: Khadijah Islamic Center (Khadijah Masjid)
Montreal (Island).Programs / Classes / Events: QURAN WEEKEND CLASSES (running 9 yrs): Sat & Sun 10:30 AM–1:30 PM, ages 5–12, Sept–June; reading + memorization. Registration via JotForm. PAST EVENTS: 'Home Schooling – A Path of Purpose' session w/ Mawlana Adil (28 Jun 2026, 1:30–5 PM); Fun Kids Activities (10 May 2026); Community Open Iftar Dinner (8 Mar 2026) w/ ICNA Montreal, Sister Sabria Foundation & Greater Montreal Dawah Network.
Montreal (Island).Pricing (verified where stated): QURAN CLASSES: $75 per month; sibling discount $20 off each additional child. Camp fees are published on poster images/registration forms (call to confirm). Marriage, counselling & hall rental fees not published — call. Iftars & halaqahs free.

Montreal (Island).Name: Salahouddine Mosque (AICP)
Montreal (Island).Address: 6691 Av. du Parc, Montréal, QC H2V 4J1
Montreal (Island).Programs / Classes / Events: One of the most program-dense mosques in Montreal. WEEKLY: Islamic lesson on belief/religious themes every Friday 7:00 PM FOLLOWED BY A FREE DINNER; Zikr & Madih + Islamic lesson every Saturday 7:30 PM; Islamic & Quran lessons for LADIES Wednesdays 10:00 PM and Fridays 7:00 PM; Quran lesson for MEN Thursdays 6:30 PM. SCHOOL: Cultural School An-Nour (Quran, Arabic, religion) Saturdays 10:00 AM–1:30 PM. SPORTS/YOUTH: men's soccer training & adult soccer team; FREE self-defence classes; scouts training on weekends. SUMMER: annual summer camp (sports, cultural & scouts activities) for families and individuals; intensive summer school (Quran, religion, Arabic) 3 days/week; group picnic every Saturday with sports. ALSO: annual Mawlid parade through Montreal streets; religious song (Madih) groups for men, women & kids; annual Hajj trip organization; Ramadan program with FREE supper + daily lessons + Taraweeh; annual Ramadan dinner with politicians/diplomats. Ma'had Institute semester program (Quran, fiqh, aqida) per attendee reports. Jumu'ah 1:30 PM (summer) / 12:30 PM (winter).
Montreal (Island).Pricing (verified where stated): Friday dinner explicitly FREE. Self-defence classes explicitly FREE. Ramadan supper FREE. School/camp fees not published online — call 514-274-6194.

Montreal (Island).Name: Canadian Islamic Centre Al-Jamieh (CICAJ)
Montreal (Island).Programs / Classes / Events: Main hall seats 1,000 — daily prayers, Jumu'ah, and both Eid prayers. SHORT COURSES after Maghrib every Saturday, Sunday, Monday & Tuesday: Quran recitation, rituals (ibadat), fiqh and sunnah. WEEKEND SCHOOL: Quran + Arabic for ~300 children aged 5–15, Saturdays or Sundays. INSTITUTE OF ISLAMIC & ARABIC STUDIES: Quran, Hadith, prayers, stories of the prophets, Arabic — for youth aged 16–30. Social activities to support families; guidance for new Muslim immigrants; welcoming/assisting new converts. Montreal (Island).Pricing (verified where stated): The Institute's courses for CHILDREN AGED 5–12 ARE EXPLICITLY FREE per the centre's own services page. Weekend-school fees for other ages not published — call 514-624-4533.

Montreal (Island).Name: Mosquée Madani / Academy An-Noor
Montreal (Island).Programs / Classes / Events: Academy An-Noor teaches Quran, Arabic, Tajweed, Tafsir, Hadith, Seerah, Du'as, Aqaa'id and Islamic culture — for ALL AGES (kids and adults), with flexible scheduling; teachers born and raised in North America. Montreal (Island).Name: Canadian Institute of Islamic Civilization (CIIC – MAC)

Montreal (Island).Name: Islamic Centre of Quebec – El Markaz Islami (ICQ)
Montreal (Island).Programs / Classes / Events: Oldest Islamic institution in Quebec (est. 1965 by Act of the National Assembly, Bill 194). Children's Quran & Islamic-studies classes held FRIDAY THROUGH MONDAY each week; separate class stream for teenage girls taught by women instructors; instruction by an Al-Madinah University graduate (Sheikh Syed Fida Bukhari) in Arabic, English and Urdu with French translation available. Marriage (nikah) services; administration of the Islamic Cemetery of Quebec and burial services; prison chaplaincy via Canada Correctional Services; annual Hajj trip with a free printed Manasek guide; library and bookstore; regular newsletter; moon-sighting announcements; delegations/tours hosted for public service, police academy and civic groups; fatwa service by email (imam@icqmontreal.com).
Montreal (Island).Pricing (verified where stated): Classes community-funded/donation-based. Marriage, funeral and cemetery services carry administrative fees set case-by-case — not published; call 514-331-1770. Hajj Manasek guide distributed free.
